runs.pr_body:
## first_words in textkit/tokens.py returns one word too many instead of exactly the first n words.

Closes: Fix first_words returning one word too many

### Plan
- Inspect textkit/tokens.py first_words implementation to locate off-by-one slice
- Fix word slicing to return exactly first n words while preserving n<=0 and over-length behavior
- Create tests/test_tokens_regression.py covering first_words('alpha beta gamma delta', 2) == 'alpha beta' plus edge cases
- Run regression test and existing tests to verify fix

### Files changed
- textkit/tokens.py
- tests/test_tokens_regression.py

### Tests
All tests pass (10 → 15 discovered).

### Reviewer
approve: Checked diff is limited to first_words off-by-one fix in textkit/tokens.py (words[:n+1] to words[:n]) plus new regression test file; no unrelated changes. Tests pass (10 before, 15 after) and regression tests cover exact n, n=1, n==len, n<=0, and n>len/empty cases.

--- new file: tests/test_tokens_regression.py ---
+"""Regression tests for first_words off-by-one fix."""
+import unittest
+
+from textkit.tokens import first_words
+
+
+class TestFirstWordsRegression(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_exact_count_returns_exactly_n_words(self):
+        self.assertEqual(first_words('alpha beta gamma delta', 2), 'alpha beta')
+
+    def test_first_one_word(self):
+        self.assertEqual(first_words('alpha beta gamma delta', 1), 'alpha')
+
+    def test_all_words_when_n_equals_length(self):
+        self.assertEqual(first_words('alpha beta gamma delta', 4), 'alpha beta gamma delta')
+
+    def test_non_positive_n_returns_empty(self):
+        self.assertEqual(first_words('alpha beta gamma delta', 0), '')
+        self.assertEqual(first_words('alpha beta gamma delta', -1), '')
+
+    def test_fewer_words_than_n_returns_all(self):
+        self.assertEqual(first_words('alpha beta', 5), 'alpha beta')
+        self.assertEqual(first_words('', 3), '')
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    unittest.main()
